title: Trump's AI Rebrand Sparks Unprecedented Demand for Slovenian Domains
seoTitle: Trump's AI Rebrand Sparks Slovenian Domain Surge
subtitle: The proposal to rename artificial intelligence to “Super Intelligence” (SI) drives interest in websites sharing the acronym in Slovenia
excerpt: The president's push to rename AI as "Super Intelligence" (SI) triggers unprecedented demand for Slovenian domain names using the acronym.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The President of the United States has proposed that artificial intelligence be referred to as Super Intelligence, abbreviated as SI. This naming shift coincided with an unexpected surge in demand for domain names registered in Slovenia that use the same initials.

Immediate Impact on Domain Registrations

Since the proposal was made public, there has been an "unprecedented" surge in demand from buyers looking to acquire web addresses containing the SI acronym under the Slovenian extension. The phenomenon highlights how a branding decision can directly influence the domain name market.

Context of the SI Acronym

The acronym SI, adopted to refer to Super Intelligence, aligns with the country-code top-level domain for Slovenia, which is .si. This coincidence has generated a wave of inquiries and registrations far exceeding the typical volume seen for these domains.

  • Proposal to rename AI to Super Intelligence (SI).
  • Coincidence with the Slovenian domain extension .si.
  • Surge in inquiries and registrations for .si domains.

With information from BBC News.
